result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred position: Corio, apparently the Customer, receives a 30-day written-notice convenience termination right and a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, while Commerce One has no convenience termination right during a committed term. However, adding a right to terminate “in part” is not required by the playbook and could disrupt bundled scope or pricing, so the change is not minimal and may alter unrelated commercial economics. Otherwise, the operative language is clear and professionally drafted.
